summary: The copy module can copy directories recursively, but synchronize (an rsync wrapper) is more efficient for many files.
questions: How do I copy a whole directory to a remote host?
What's faster than copy for thousands of files?

answer_card.title: Copy files recursively
answer_card.answer_md:
`ansible.builtin.copy` copies directories recursively (`src: dir/`). For many files use **`ansible.posix.synchronize`**, which wraps rsync:

```yaml
- ansible.posix.synchronize:
    src: files/site/
    dest: /var/www/site/
```
